statusDetail: Coverage-complete atomic audit of six representative GOV.UK templates, one transactional step, and a 404 recovery state. Excluded: external sign-in destinations, authenticated account areas, payment/checkout, individual country pages, and every sitemap URL because they are separate hosts/flows or duplicate the selected archetypes.

page.notes: Large public information and government-service directory. Representative templates were selected rather than attempting millions of sitemap URLs.

checkOutcomes.method: screenshot comparison plus computed CSS media-rule probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Screenshot and CSS probe under prefers-color-scheme: dark showed no palette adaptation.

checkOutcomes.method: emulated preference plus getAnimations() and CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The reduced-motion emulation was active, no running animations were exposed, and the stylesheet includes reduced-motion handling.

checkOutcomes.method: contrast emulation screenshot plus CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Forced/high-contrast CSS rules are present and the prefers-contrast screenshot retained visible text and controls.

checkOutcomes.method: cross-template journey observation and CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative same-origin route changes were abrupt and multiple templates had no View Transition declaration.

checkOutcomes.method: visual review and stylesheet animation-timeline inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scroll-linked visual effect or scroll event animation was observed on the representative templates; the UI does not implement a main-thread parallax anti-pattern.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM control inventory and interaction review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Navigation and disclosure interactions use native links, buttons, details, and standard scrolling; no custom pointermove gesture layer was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: long-page screenshots and navigation DOM review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited pages avoid persistent sticky chrome that needs scroll-state adaptation; contents, step, and A-Z navigation remain available in document flow.
No tooltip or floating menu that could drift from an anchor was present on the audited paths; menus are in-flow and edge-safe.

checkOutcomes.method: screenshots, heading inventory, and focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Breadcrumbs, contents links, step navigation, descriptive headings, and visible focus cues consistently orient users.
The cookie choice is an in-flow banner that pushes rather than obscures content, offers accept/reject/settings equally, and no modal interstitial appeared.
Audited controls use native buttons, fieldsets, radios, selects, and details; no ad-hoc modal div was found.
Screenshots show a restrained design with content-dominant layouts, limited framing, and consistent navigation/footer chrome.
All six representative templates reported 0px horizontal overflow at 360x800 and included a viewport meta tag.

checkOutcomes.method: stylesheet signal probe plus narrow screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Container-query and logical-property signals are present in major shared templates, and mobile screenshots show components reflowing rather than merely shrinking.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility plus focus and mobile visual probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 1.0; controls retained strong focus styling and the mobile layouts kept controls usable.
Each archetype exposes a descriptive H1 and an obvious next action: search, topic links, contents, country lookup, or Start now.

checkOutcomes.method: representative search and calculator journey walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: A passport query returned 5,962 filterable results and the State Pension journey advanced from its landing page to a clearly labelled first question without an account wall.

checkOutcomes.method: result-state DOM review and deliberate 404 exercise
checkOutcomes.evidence: The search reports its result count and a deliberately invalid route returns a titled 404 with homepage and search recovery routes.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse plus trace and layout observer
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 1.6s and TBT 0ms but CLS 0.565, above the good threshold.
Lighthouse reported CLS 0.565; the separate mobile observer also recorded a late shift at 2.37s, though only 0.0129.
The trace and Lighthouse both recorded zero long tasks/zero total blocking time.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against live script attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load transferred 205,446 bytes in 17 successful requests with no cache, compression, redirect, or HTTP hygiene warnings; the flagged application script is type=module at the body end and therefore deferred by platform semantics.
Lighthouse estimated 26,909 bytes unused JS and 39,277 bytes unused CSS on the homepage.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility and DOM form inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 1.0 with image-alt, form-label, and link-name audits passing; DOM probes found labels on representative fields.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse contrast audit and emulated screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse colour contrast passed and the high-contrast screenshot preserved legible controls and text.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse structure audit, landmark inventory, and focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse heading order passed; landmarks and headings were present on all templates, with skip navigation and visible high-contrast focus styling.

checkOutcomes.method: visual review across desktop and narrow layouts
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative desktop and 360px screenshots show generous line spacing, readable measure, clear hierarchy, and no clipping or overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: mobile layouts, viewport inspection, and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: All templates reflowed at 360px without horizontal overflow, viewport scaling was not disabled, and Lighthouse accessibility scored 1.0. No audited path contained time-based media requiring captions.
Lighthouse found no browser errors logged to the console.
Lighthouse doctype and charset audits passed; all homepage images had explicit dimensions and correct display proportions.
Lighthouse best-practices scored 1.0 and reported no BFCache blocker; no permission prompt or paste prevention appeared during the paths.
Every representative template had a descriptive title and meta description.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse SEO, robots/sitemap fetch, discoverability diff
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse SEO scored 1.0; links, viewport, and robots audits passed, while raw HTML retained all rendered content words.

checkOutcomes.method: metadata probes plus robots/sitemap and fetch status
checkOutcomes.evidence: Public pages returned 200 and robots.txt points to a current sitemap; canonical URLs were present on homepage, article, calculator, and intentionally noindexed search canonicalized to the search endpoint.
Entity-bearing article and service templates exposed JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata; the homepage also exposed social metadata.
HTTPS, nonce-based CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy were present. The sole first-party preference cookie was Secure and not authentication-sensitive.
Before optional consent, the network and tracker probes observed zero third-party requests/origins and no known trackers.

No browser permission request occurred on load and no authentication form was present in the audited GOV.UK templates; sign-in destinations were links to separate services, so passkey support was not asserted here.
HSTS, SAMEORIGIN/frame-ancestors, a nonce CSP, strict-origin referrer policy, and a permissions policy were all active; no third-party cookie was set.
Raw-server HTML contained 100% of rendered content words on homepage, article, and search, with titles/descriptions preserved and no empty app shell.

checkOutcomes.method: menu interaction, overlay inventory, and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: Native, in-flow controls avoided clipped overlays; the menu toggled aria-expanded predictably and no console/runtime error was reported.

The audited property is a public, server-rendered information and service directory rather than an installable web app; offline completion of live government transactions was not treated as a requirement.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited property is a public, server-rendered information and service directory rather than an installable web app; offline completion of live government transactions was not treated as a requirement.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A deliberate unknown route returned a clear Page not found state, status code 404, and actionable homepage/search recovery.
All representative documents declared lang=en and shared CSS included logical inline/block properties; content and reading order were coherent.
The representative public paths are deliberately UK-English and did not present currency, user-locale number formatting, or locale-selectable data requiring an Intl comparison.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative public paths are deliberately UK-English and did not present currency, user-locale number formatting, or locale-selectable data requiring an Intl comparison.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No audited path displayed or accepted time-zone-sensitive events or timestamps; a time-zone/DST implementation claim would be fabricated.
checkOutcomes.reason: No audited path displayed or accepted time-zone-sensitive events or timestamps; a time-zone/DST implementation claim would be fabricated.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Cookie accept and reject actions have equal prominence, settings are linked, and no disguised advertising, forced continuity, or confirmshaming appeared.
The calculator uses a clear fieldset/radio question and preserves browser/server navigation; the exercised 404 uses plain language and recovery actions rather than blame.
Search and filter inputs had explicit labels and appropriate input types; autocomplete=off was limited to searches and a bot-trap, not personal identity/payment fields.

No checkout, subscription, authentication, consent grant beyond optional cookies, or account-management form was part of the representative GOV.UK-owned paths; outbound sign-in services were not audited as this host.
checkOutcomes.reason: No checkout, subscription, authentication, consent grant beyond optional cookies, or account-management form was part of the representative GOV.UK-owned paths; outbound sign-in services were not audited as this host.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The image audit found four legacy PNG promotional images and one 240px app icon rendered at 80px, although all were dimensioned and lazy-loaded.
The page loaded only 17 requests, transferred 205KB, had no third-party requests, and trace observers saw no long tasks or persistent animation.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR resource budget and visual review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage transferred 205KB with zero third-party bytes, no audio/video, no autoplay, and only 25KB of images.

checkOutcomes.method: site profile and no-JavaScript content inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: This is an information and navigation publication with crawlable semantic HTML, not a declared agent-action surface; no WebMCP capability requirement was inferred.
checkOutcomes.reason: This is an information and navigation publication with crawlable semantic HTML, not a declared agent-action surface; no WebMCP capability requirement was inferred.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation or language-model feature is offered on the audited pages, so requiring on-device inference would add a feature unrelated to the site’s stated tasks.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation or language-model feature is offered on the audited pages, so requiring on-device inference would add a feature unrelated to the site’s stated tasks.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten menu open/close cycles, heap grew only 69,109 bytes (1.14%) and 800 nodes (0.71%); constructor populations remained essentially stable.
The homepage heap was about 6.04MB with 112,444 snapshot nodes, proportionate for the 129-control server-rendered page.
No Detached constructor appeared among the top constructors, and repeated menu interaction added only 7 closures and 2 arrays, with no material accumulation signal.

principleOutcomes.reason: The site has no declared agent-facing or on-device-inference surface; both emerging checks were judged out of scope with check-specific rationales.

paths.description: Homepage and global navigation template; entry point, cookie choice, search, and service discovery.
Topic listing archetype representing browse and taxonomy navigation.
Long-form guidance archetype with contents navigation and structured metadata.
Search results and filtering form, representing query and refinement tasks.
Transactional service landing page and first State Pension calculator question.
Large A-Z listing and country-search archetype.
Representative HTTP failure and recovery state.

findings.summary: GOV.UK does not adapt its palette to the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot is pixel-identical in appearance and file size (69,468 bytes) to the default screenshot; the computed CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and add a preference-driven dark palette using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), preserving GOV.UK contrast and forced-colour behavior.

findings.summary: Cross-document navigation still swaps pages abruptly rather than using progressively enhanced View Transitions.
findings.evidence: Representative MPA journeys across homepage, topic, guidance, search, and calculator pages were exercised; no visible transition was present, and several template probes contained no view-transition CSS. The pages remain fully usable.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enable same-origin cross-document View Transitions and use restrained directional transitions that are disabled under reduced motion.

findings.summary: The lab Core Web Vitals run fails the good CLS threshold despite fast paint and an idle main thread.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 1.6 s and TBT 0 ms, but CLS 0.565, producing a performance score of 0.78. A separate 360px layout observation measured CLS 0.0129, so the shift is condition-sensitive but reproducible in Lighthouse.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a Lighthouse trace to identify the shifted nodes, reserve their space before paint, and verify CLS below 0.1 across clean desktop and mobile runs.

findings.summary: The homepage has a substantial condition-dependent layout shift during the Lighthouse load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported cumulative layout shift 0.565. The independent mobile observer saw one smaller shift at 2.37 s (0.0129), confirming late movement even though the magnitude differed by run condition.
findings.suggestedFix: Locate the Lighthouse layout-shift sources, reserve dimensions for late UI, fonts, and consent state, then regression-test clean-profile loads.

findings.summary: The homepage ships a mostly unused shared CSS bundle and a substantially unused JavaScript bundle.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 39,277 bytes (93.2%) of the 42,156-byte application CSS and 26,909 bytes (64.3%) of the 41,825-byte application JavaScript were unused on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Split template-specific CSS and JavaScript from the shared bundle, preserving caching while loading homepage features conditionally.

findings.summary: Homepage promotional raster assets are all legacy PNGs, and the app icon is delivered at three times its rendered width.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 4 legacy PNG images and the 240px GOV.UK app icon rendered at 80px. All images had explicit dimensions and below-fold lazy loading, limiting the impact.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve appropriately sized AVIF/WebP alternatives with responsive sources while retaining the existing width, height, and lazy-loading behavior.

taskList.title: Identify and eliminate the clean-load homepage layout shift
Add a preference-driven dark colour scheme
Split unused shared CSS and JavaScript by template/feature
Right-size and modernise homepage promotional images
Progressively enhance MPA navigation with restrained cross-document transitions
